summary: First research run (2026-10-04). The baseline (v3.1 rules on XRP, SOL and ETH) was tested against five single-rule changes suggested by the pack: break-even, two targets, an hour filter and a wider swing stop. All five were rejected on the history.

proposals.name: be_1r
proposals.hypothesis: 34 of the baseline's 93 stopped trades first reached +0.5R. Moving the stop to break-even after +1R should turn some full losses into scratches.
proposals.expected: more R per trade, a few more scratches

proposals.name: tp_125
proposals.hypothesis: Many stopped trades had been in profit (34 of 93 reached +0.5R). A closer target should be hit more often.
proposals.expected: higher win rate, similar R per trade

proposals.name: tp_2
proposals.hypothesis: Winners at the 1.5R target average +1.48R; if the moves often run further, a 2R target earns more per winner.
proposals.expected: lower win rate, more R per trade

proposals.name: session_04_20
proposals.hypothesis: Entries between 20:00 and 04:00 UTC are the weakest hours: +0.116R and +0.178R a trade, against +0.22R to +0.39R in the other hours.

proposals.name: lookback_15
proposals.hypothesis: A swing stop over 15 candles sits further from the noise and should be stopped out less often.
